S1 — MATERIAL (P2). packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemCandleLifecycle.ts:47 (and :61, which makes cast-gate executable). Newly ready cast-gate has an action cost but no bound spell identity. Concrete reproduced scenario on the unmodified bundled pack: start a PC combat turn, provide an owned/attuned fresh Candle, spend a bonus action casting spell:healing-word, then useItem(...operationId: 'cast-gate'). Both succeed; the Candle is consumed, actionUsed and bonusActionUsed are true, but otherSpellCast remains 'none'. Reverse the order and Healing Word also succeeds after gate. The printed Candle alternative casts gate; SRD bonus-action casting permits no other spell that turn except an action cantrip. spendActivationTurnResource (itemState.ts:2343-2346) consequently passes itemOperation:true instead of spellRef:'spell:gate' to the existing spell-timing guard (actionEconomy.ts:1153-1183). This violates authoritative accounting (owning AC2, dispatch C2) and ADR0020's engine-owned resource/state boundary. DM ownership of gate's effects does not authorize recording its casting as a non-spell action; the tool also tells the DM not to spend a second action. Scope/siblings: of the four newly executable operations, only cast-gate casts a spell; move-levers, light, and snuff need no spell identity. Tested both ordering dimensions, fresh instance identity, real attunement, and real combat accounting. Suggested fix: connect this source-backed cast to spell:gate in the authoritative accounting path while retaining one lighting action and DM adjudication of effects, with honest readiness for any added binding; alternatively retain an explicit blocker for cast-gate until that accounting can be supported (dispatch C2 permits a spell-hook refusal). Required permanent evidence: a generalized real-pack spell-accounting invariant for this newly executable cast, covering both orderings with a bonus-action spell and transactional preservation of the Candle/action when refused; this is proportionate to a live rules/accounting defect. Implementation owner: PR #694 / eshyra-7f0h. Repair is material and needs a fresh full review at its new exact head before approval.

Other scope conclusions: Apparatus grouping/selection and source cells are faithful; Candle paid lighting, free burn updates, relighting, first-light-only gate eligibility, and destruction behave as specified apart from S1. The unused excludes field is pre-existing; this Candle's new lifecycle enforces the relevant exclusion. Legacy-state migration: no requirement under the explicit pre-v1 no-compatibility policy in ADR0013/0015. No non-material findings.
